Hub fee: 2.5 fils per successful chargeable data/payment call (account-information sub-resources incl. transactions/standing-orders/direct-debits/scheduled-payments, confirmation-of-payee, payment initiation); balances & CoP drop to 0.5 fils when the same (date, LFI, TPP) also has an accepted payment that day (same-day pairing proxy for the '<2h' rule -- exact timestamps are not in the public aggregated logs).
